item.description:
• design(icon): a mascara wand on the diagonal
  • design(dmg): one coat of black, the name cut out of a censor bar
  • fix(app): ask for screen recording in a card sized to fit, not the preview window
  • feat: Maskara, with a Liquid Glass icon, a sprayed-on DMG and a guided first run
  • feat(sidecar): find secrets by shape, since OCR garbles them
  • fix: show the presented app instead of blurring the whole screen

• build: re-sign Sparkle's helpers with Developer ID so notarization accepts them
  • docs: a readme in maskara-ai's style, with a picture of what the call sees
  • ci: check the release secrets on Linux before a release spends macOS minutes
  • feat: ship maskara as a notarized mac app that updates itself
  • feat: prototype screen-share masking on maskara-ai
